description: This file contains source code for configuring a Toyota JZS147 engine within a firmware project. It includes functions to set engine specifications, trigger modes, ignition and injection pin configurations, thermistor settings, and engine operation modes for different variants like VVTi and non-VVTi. The code is part of an engine control system, likely for an aftermarket or custom ECU implementation.

methods.name: common2jz
methods.description: Configures common engine parameters for the Toyota JZS147 engine, including engine specs, ignition, injection pins, fuel pump, thermistor setup, and engine chart size.

methods.name: setToyota_jzs147EngineConfiguration
methods.description: Sets the engine configuration for a standard JZS147 engine with specific trigger and mode settings.

methods.name: setToyota_2jz_vics
methods.description: Configures the engine for a VICS variant with specific trigger type, input pins, and VVT mode.
